description: This bar chart, titled "Evaluation Based on Different Tasks," displays accuracy values for three different models—labeled in the legend as "Base" (reddish-brown), "RMU with Enhanced GCG" (olive-green), and "RMU" (tan)—across two distinct evaluation tasks shown on the horizontal axis: "MCQ Eval" and "Generation Eval." The vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.6, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. For the "MCQ Eval" task, the "Base" model achieves an accuracy of 0.644, the "RMU with Enhanced GCG" model achieves 0.539, and the "RMU" model achieves 0.299. For the "Generation Eval" task, the "Base" model achieves an accuracy of 0.597, the "RMU with Enhanced GCG" model achieves 0.263, and the "RMU" model achieves 0.106. Each bar is a stacked bar, with the "Base" model's accuracy represented by the full height of the bar, while the "RMU with Enhanced GCG" and "RMU" accuracies are shown as stacked segments on top of each other. The bars are grouped by task and are not sorted; the "MCQ Eval" group is positioned on the left and the "Generation Eval" group is on the right. The chart does not visually emphasize any particular bar through shading, bolding, or outlining.
